title: Sliding-window rate limiter
prompt:
Implement RateLimiter in ratelimit.py.

RateLimiter(limit, window) allows at most `limit` events per key in any
window-length interval measured on a caller-supplied clock.

allow(key, now) returns True and records the event when the key has fewer than
`limit` events with timestamp > now - window; otherwise it returns False and
records nothing.

remaining(key, now) returns how many more events the key may record right now.
reset_at(key, now) returns the timestamp at which the oldest live event expires,
or None when the key has no live events.

Events are per key: one key's traffic must never affect another's. Events exactly
`window` old must no longer count. Memory must not grow without bound when a key
stops being used: state older than the window is dropped on access.

Only ratelimit.py should change.
